mentions.name: RCHIVE
mentions.description: A cross-platform desktop app for cataloging, searching, and reorganizing files across computers and drives. It scans many different sources, provides unified deep search across the entire catalog including offline drives, lets users virtually organize and clean up large archives, and resiliently copies or moves files when restructuring on disk. Includes previews and metadata browsing, works on Windows, Mac, and Linux, runs offline with zero telemetry, deletes nothing, is fully deterministic with no AI-based classification, and offers portable versions runnable from a USB drive.
mentions.problem: Decades of poorly-organized files scattered across computers, NAS devices, backups, and folders become progressively harder to manage, and a drive starting to fail raised the stakes; consulting work also dried up, prompting the build.
